notes: Defaults for the machine-wide resource queue (scripts/resource-queue.mjs; spec: docs/resource-queue.md). Override per user in <claude dir>/agent-companion/config/resource-rules.json (objects merge key by key, 'rules' merges by id, 'classes' merges by id, other arrays replace) or point AC_RESOURCE_RULES at a file. M = measured, E = estimate; E values are conservative placeholders. A value of null or 0 turns a limit off.

ram.notes: reserveMb null = auto: max(reserveMinMb, reserveFraction of total RAM), i.e. max(2 GB, 12.5%): 8 GB on a 64 GB machine, 2 GB up to 16 GB. A number in reserveMb (your own file) overrides it. A grant needs free RAM, minus the reserve, minus the RAM of leases younger than rampMs (granted but not yet at their peak), to cover the request.

box.notes: capacity is the CI budget (CI_LOCAL_BUDGET, default max(2, floor(cores / 2))); sized from the machine, never set here

classes.notes: M: 8 emulator JVMs + about 12 Chrome (plan: 4.8 GB per 8 slots)
E2E with a spec path still boots the pool (M)
lint + vitest + E2E in sequence, charged at its peak phase; M: loaded full runs 10-18 min, so the over-time flag sits at 30 min (E)
qemu AVD; a daemon, so run it in the wrapper's foreground (pid-bound hold)
exclusive per project directory ({cwd} becomes an 8-hex hash of the working directory)
npm ci; disk and Defender bound (E)
node --test over a whole directory (not ci-local, which holds its own lease); E: the ci-budget plain budget is 8

rules.when: the holder or requester pid is not alive; cleared at once

no heartbeat for the stale age (CI_LOCAL_BUDGET_STALE_MS, default 90 s). A lease whose wrapper pid is verified live (the process started no later than the grant, so it is not a reused pid) is flagged HEARTBEAT STALE and kept until the live-holder-ceiling rule; a pid that cannot be verified is released as before
a queued requester's pid is not alive (the record names this rule for tickets)

a lease is older than its limit: its class's maxHoldMs, else the smallest maxHoldMs of the resources it holds. A live holder (its wrapper pid or bound pid is alive) is not released by this rule: it is flagged OVER TIME in status and kept, whatever it holds and whatever its probe says, until the live-holder-ceiling rule

the lease is at least minHoldMs old and, for idleMs, its process tree used under minCpuPct of one core, held no listening socket in the class's port bands and had no busy child; needs the wrapper's activity sidecar, so a lease nobody measures is never idle-flagged. A live holder is not released by this rule: it is flagged IDLE? in status and kept, until the live-holder-ceiling rule; a dead holder is cleared (pid-dead)

a live holder flagged by max-hold, idle or a stale heartbeat has held its lease longer than ceilingMs (4 h, from the grant): the sweep releases it and logs this rule with the flag that held it (evidence.flaggedBy). A value of null or 0 for ceilingMs, or enabled false, keeps a flagged live holder until it exits. Release one earlier by hand: resource-queue.mjs release <lease-id>
